notes.title: Refunct Update 10
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aZcGfuC.jpg[/img]

Hey all! Refunct Update 10 is now live which improves movement, optimization and more:
[list][*]Added mid-air step-up mechanic making movement smoother by adding leeway when barely missing edges on landing
[*]Added 10-40% resolution scale for extremely low-end systems
[*]Improved climbing at steep angles
[*]Improved collision consistency by always using flat movement base
[*]Improved performance using LODs, model and render tweaks
[*]Fixed jerky physics while moving on rising islands
[*]Fixed camera dipping into water in rare cases
[*]Increased minimum required climb height slightly
[*]Tweaked button collision by tapering off the top to fix sliding in rare cases with the collision changes
[/list]

This update has been iterated on with the critical and passionate [url=https://discord.gg/s5AKngv]speedrun community[/url]. Also you can now name your price and pay what you want for [url=https://kristofferson.bandcamp.com/album/connections]Refunct's soundtrack / OST by Kristofferson[/url] getting it in high-quality MP3, FLAC and more.

Finally Refunct was released two years ago and I really just wanted to thank you all for your support.

Take care!

notes.title: Refunct Update 9
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jOoiTKY.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! Refunct Update 9 is now live which adds better water reflections, 6 new achievements, 11 new languages and more:[list][*]Added lit and shadowed real-time planar water reflections on at least medium and especially ultra effects quality settings (not supported on Linux)
[*]Added 6 achievements
[*]Added Arabic (not supported on Linux), Bulgarian, Czech, European Portuguese, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Romanian, Thai, Traditional Chinese and Ukrainian localization
[*]Added right-to-left UI layout support for Arabic
[*]Improved some existing localizations
[*]Improved outro text quality
[*]Fixed maintaining velocity when walljumping off of the very top of objects
[*]Fixed resetting language to default on macOS and Linux
[*]Tweaked automatically detected quality settings
[*]Tweaked alternate outro text criteria
[*]Tweaked selecting first played music on startup
[/list][h1]Achievements[/h1]
Of the new achievements there are 3 which add additional questions asked from the collected cubes which will be automatically awarded if you start Refunct on a completed save.

The other 3 achievements are about finishing Refunct under a certain completion% and in specific times [u]adding challenge[/u] while still being very fair for those wanting to experience the depth of the movement system and introducing [u]different ways to play[/u] Refunct. They were added due to high [u]demand for replayability[/u] after getting 100% Refunct in-game and to make sure that Refunct has the same features on Steam compared to the recently released Xbox One version.

I am sorry for those that might feel temporarily robbed of one of their "Perfect Games" due to adding those achievements post-release so if you are not able to complete them please feel free to send me a mail to the address found on the [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGameTechnicalIssue?appid=406150]support page[/url] so I can unlock them for you.

[h1]Speedrun[/h1]
Also consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/s5AKngv]Refunct speedrun community[/url] and challenge yourself further by submitting your recorded runs to the [url=http://www.speedrun.com/Refunct]official leaderboard[/url] where you can see some cool tricks and optimal routes which may be helpful for getting the achievements.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
Hopefully adding those [u]completely optional[/u] achievements and other improvements like better reflections adds more value to you guys. Additionally Refunct is now available in all 27 languages currently supported by Steam thanks to the translations done by this awesome community.

Your continued support and understanding is very appreciated. Take care!

notes.title: Refunct Update 8
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ajhrqtw.jpg[/img]

Hi! Refunct Update 8 has been released which aims to reduce causing motion sickness for people prone to it and incorporates various player feedback:
[list]
[*]Improved camera smoothness by using flat movement base collision on the ground
[*]Fixed a few localization strings
[*]Fixed showing incorrect restart message in rare cases
[*]Fixed executable icon after Update 7
[*]Tweaked hiding restart message after first instead of second restart after game completion
[*]Tweaked default quality scaling
[*]Reverted island rise timing changes of Update 7
[/list]

Additionally if you are very prone to motion sickness the following may help further:
[list]
[*]Try to not think about motion sickness
[*]Reduce mouse/gamepad sensitivity
[*]Tweak the graphics settings to run Refunct with at least 60 fps
[*]Tweak the field of view
[*]Set anti-aliasing to low or none
[*]Do not hide the reticle
[/list]

notes.title: Refunct Update 4
notes.content:
Due to popular demand a new update has been released to improve the speedrunning experience including a completion timer, instant restarts and more!

[h1]Speedrun[/h1]
Head over to [url=http://www.speedrun.com/Refunct]speedrun.com/Refunct[/url] to take part in the speedrun community. Simply record a video of your run, press the menu button during Refunct's outro to show the completion time (after completing the game at least once), upload it to Youtube or similar and submit it.

[h1]Livesplit[/h1]
Advanced Windows users can use Livesplit to get a timer overlay with splits on each button press. Simply [url=http://livesplit.github.io/downloads]download Livesplit[/url], extract it, start Livesplit executable, right-click opened window, choose Open Splits > From URL, paste [url=http://refunctgame.com/splits]http://refunctgame.com/splits[/url] and click OK, right-click window again, choose Edit Splits and press Activate, then start Refunct, go to ESC > Options > Window Mode > Switch to Windowed Fullscreen and start running. You only manually need to reset Livesplit after a completed run using a hotkey as defined in Livesplit settings.

[h1]Discord[/h1]
You can also join the community moderated [url=https://discord.gg/s5AKngv]Refunct speedrun Discord server[/url] to chat with the runners and get help setting up Livesplit.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added game completion timer shown in menu during outro after completing game once
[*]Added instant game restart
[*]Added persistent music and time of day through restarts
[*]Added underwater low-pass music filter
[*]Added exit game confirmation dialog
[*]Added focusing restart button on menu and hiding level restart confirmation after second restart
[*]Tweaked memory layout for better compatibility with external speedrun tools
[*]Removed loading screen
[/list]
